messages:
Marta: Quick async check-in for the runtime-slice sprint — posting current state + asks.
Marta: TL;DR: kernel PR landed (refs PR #412) with the slice handshake change; canary shows ~10% p99 win for 512-token paths but we see higher CPU on microbatch. Need owners for warmup policy, KV eviction rules, and a quick CR sweep.
Sanjay: I can own the warmup policy tuning. I skimmed the PR, looks good. Will run a focused canary that disables microbatch fusion and compare.
Alex: I can do the KV eviction heuristics. Noticed cache size metrics jumped on canary-2 — need traces for sequence-length distribution.
TJ: FYI I started a perf run against canary-2: link: https://dash.redwoodinternal/boards/slice-canary-2 (please open if you have access)
TJ: Early results: throughput steady, tail latency improves, but CPU ":chart_with_upwards_trend:" for microbatch paths.
Leah: Can we get the exact config used in the canary? specifically batch_window_ms and max_batch_size.
Marta: config snippet from the canary (runbook):
```
runtime.batch_window_ms: 8
runtime.max_batch_size: 64
runtime.kv_prefetch: true
runtime.warmup_policy: "prefix-priming-v2"
```
Marta: @Sanjay can you try batch_window_ms=5 and batch_size=48 for the warmup run?
Sanjay: Yep — I'll spin that up in the next 15m. Posting logs back here.
Alex: For KV eviction: current heuristic is LRU with time-decay factor. I propose adding size-aware eviction for multi-token keys — will sketch PR tonight.
TJ: Quick note — I saw a regression in sequence cache hit-rate when prefix-priming-v2 is enabled for chat flows. Might be because of kv key normalization change in PR. Putting a TODO: validate normalization for multi-turn.
Leah: Who's on CR for PR #412? I can do a focused pass on the handshake logic and the tests.
Marta: @Leah that would be great. Also @Alex please annotate expected metric deltas in your PR so SRE can make an automated alert if it flips.
Alex: Will do. Also adding a small perf harness to simulate 1k concurrent short-turn chats.
ops-bot: Canary deployment started: canary-2 -> slice-pool-3 at 1718504720. Rollout ID: canary-1718504720
ci-bot: CI passed for PR #412 (unit + integration). E2E failing on one flaky test: runtime/seq_window/test_replay.py::test_replay_timeout
Sanjay: E2E failure looks unrelated — it's the replay timeout exceeding with new handshake delay. I'll add a test tweak + comment.
Marta: Owners summary: Warmup policy tweak — Sanjay; KV eviction heuristic — Alex; CR on handshake + tests — Leah; Microbatch regression triage — TJ. Please update the ownership tracker: https://docs.redwood/ops/runtime-sprint-ownership
Marta: Dependencies: infra needs a small kernel image bump (infra-PR #88) and the gpu-runtime lib must be pinned to v2.7 (blocked on eng-infra approval).
TJ: Pinged eng-infra for the image bump. @eng-infra please review infra-PR #88 — blocking the canary promotion.
Leah: Quick CR note: add a comment in kernel/handshake explaining why we choose prefix-priming-v2 over v1 (helps future revert).
Marta: Final ask: if you are running local perf runs, paste a one-line result here like `p99=XYZms, qps=NNN, cpu=XX%` so we can collate.
Sanjay: Running now. I'll post results in ~25m.
Alex: Starting local sim: p99=155ms, qps=860, cpu=72% (microbatch disabled)
TJ: My focused run with batch_window_ms=5: p99=165ms, qps=900, cpu=78% (microbatch enabled)
Marta: Thanks all — will collect these and set a short sync if we need a live triage after Sanjay's run. Otherwise we'll keep this async. :thumbsup:
Leah: Thanks — adding my CR ping to #code-review queue.
ops-bot: Canary health check: all probes green at 1718505390. No error-rate increase detected.
Marta: Closing note: updated sprint board with these ownerships and next steps. If anything urgent, react with :fire: on this thread.
